shaders.name: Bulb Reliquary
shaders.description: A raymarched Mandelbulb whose power breathes between 7 and 9, so the lobes bud and reabsorb without ever repeating. Distance estimation uses the Hubbard-Douady potential; the colour is a slow gradient across the surface rather than an orbit-trap texture, which keeps the neon reading as form instead of noise.
shaders.useCase: Centrepiece visual for a slow build; holds attention on a large surface without cutting.

shaders.name: Boxfold Cathedral
shaders.description: A Mandelbox run at negative scale, which hollows the solid into vaulted interiors and eroded galleries. Each face takes its own neon from the surface normal, so the box reads as architecture rather than a single lit mass as the camera swings around it.
shaders.useCase: Architectural projection onto a flat façade — the box edges line up with a real building.

shaders.name: Menger Vault
shaders.description: A Menger sponge orbited at a tilt so its square voids swing open and shut as it turns. Held to three subdivision levels deliberately: a fourth drops the smallest cubes below a pixel and the whole sponge dissolves into aliasing glitter.
shaders.useCase: Rhythmic, grid-locked visual that cuts cleanly on the beat; good against four-on-the-floor.

shaders.name: Liquid Metatron
shaders.description: A breathing Metatron-style lattice of rings and struts, folded into six-fold symmetry and smeared into itself by seven accumulated time-offset copies — a feedback trail rendered without a feedback buffer, so it stays a single self-contained pass.
shaders.useCase: Slow intro visuals, ambient VJ loop between sets, held title cards.

shaders.name: Hexad Bloom
shaders.description: A flower-of-life lattice falling away down a twelve-slice kaleidoscopic tunnel. Ring thickness is divided by the tunnel’s own derivative so the cells hold a constant on-screen width instead of aliasing into spokes at the vanishing point.
shaders.useCase: Peak-time tunnel visuals, projection mapping onto a centred architectural feature.

shaders.name: Moiré Yantra
shaders.description: Three counter-rotating ring systems beat against each other into drifting moiré fringes while a pair of yantra triangles counter-rotate around a central bindu. The interference is raised to a high power so only the fringe crests light up and the field stays black.
shaders.useCase: Hypnotic mid-set bed, meditation and ritual visuals, slow-build openers.
